name: Scar for a Scar / life-one-lower
notes: CR6.6.1c-d: on play, queue a separate layer; life is checked on that layer resolution. No response changes life in this case before that layer resolves. Printed Scar red checks strictly less life when its play trigger resolves. 19 versus 20 makes condition True. Attack deals 4, and resolution returns exactly 1 action point. The lower-life case crosses the life comparison after damage: go again persists because it was granted when its play trigger resolves.
